New Shingle Roof Installation in Piedmont, CA | ROOF EXPRESS

Expert Residential Roofing Project Completed in Piedmont

At ROOF EXPRESS, we recently completed a high-quality new shingle roof installation in Piedmont, California, delivering durability, curb appeal, and long-term protection for the homeowner. Piedmont’s unique blend of historic homes and modern architecture requires a roofing approach that combines craftsmanship with advanced materials—and that’s exactly what our team delivered.

Why Homeowners in Piedmont Choose Asphalt Shingle Roofing

Piedmont homes are exposed to seasonal weather changes, including moisture, sun exposure, and occasional high winds. Asphalt shingles remain one of the most popular roofing systems due to:

Durability against California climate conditions

Cost-effectiveness compared to other roofing materials

Wide range of styles and colors to match Piedmont architecture

Ease of maintenance and repair

Fire resistance, which is critical in Northern California

For this project, the homeowner selected architectural shingles designed to enhance both performance and aesthetics.

Project Overview: Shingle Roof Replacement in Piedmont

Location:

Piedmont, CA

Scope of Work:

Full tear-off of the existing roof system

Inspection of roof decking and structural components

Replacement of damaged plywood sheathing

Installation of premium underlayment for moisture protection

New architectural asphalt shingles installation

Flashing replacement around vents, chimneys, and penetrations

Ridge vent installation for improved attic ventilation

Our Roofing Process

At ROOF EXPRESS, every roofing project follows a structured and professional process:

1. Roof Inspection & Planning

We began with a detailed inspection to assess the existing roof condition and identify any structural concerns.

2. Tear-Off & Preparation

The old roofing materials were completely removed, allowing us to inspect the decking and ensure a solid foundation.

3. Decking Repairs

Any compromised wood sheathing was replaced to meet safety and building standards.

4. Underlayment Installation

A high-performance underlayment was installed to provide an additional moisture barrier.

5. Shingle Installation

We installed premium architectural shingles using manufacturer-approved techniques to ensure longevity and warranty compliance.

6. Final Inspection & Cleanup

Our team conducted a full quality check and left the property clean and ready to enjoy.

Benefits of This New Roof for the Homeowner

This new shingle roof provides:

Enhanced curb appeal increasing property value

Improved energy efficiency with better ventilation

Long-term protection against leaks and weather damage

Peace of mind with professional installation and warranties

Why Choose ROOF EXPRESS in Piedmont, CA

As a Diamond Certified roofing company, ROOF EXPRESS is trusted by homeowners across the Bay Area. We bring:

Certified and experienced roofing crews

High-quality materials from top manufacturers

Transparent pricing and detailed project communication

Proven track record of successful roofing projects

We understand the architectural standards and roofing requirements specific to Piedmont and surrounding cities.

Serving Piedmont and the Greater Bay Area

In addition to Piedmont, we proudly provide roofing services in:

Oakland

San Francisco
